goal: Extend the existing eight Nilaza Growth roles with isolated YouTube briefs and offline planning/preflight; no duplicate queue or publisher.
successCriteria: Same eight canonical Growth role IDs; script, motion and audio are content_studio workstreams.
Nilaza brand, editorial ledger, assets, outputs, channel, budget and proposed weekly slots remain tenant isolated.
Offline checks reject stale claims, mismatched channels, duplicate intent, unknown rights, stale approval, unsafe schedules, ambiguity and over-budget requests.
Production providers, OAuth, scheduler and external publishing remain disabled with explicit blockers; ContentOps integration is contract-only.
Pending Mystic Art handle does not select/pin a channel; conservative proposal is at most one long and one Short per week, all timing and activation still unapproved.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile, web, Admin UI and generated snapshots remain unchanged.
Growth Core, existing carousel runtime/renderer and approved six-image pilot are untouched.
Production database, remote Git, Mây content and ContentOps runtime/queue remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Read-only local Node CLI plans draft YouTube work and prints activation blockers.
impact.dataWrite: New sanitized config, role briefs, empty editorial ledger and offline validator/test files only; no queue or runtime state writes.
impact.backendContract: Draft handoff contract to existing ContentOps; no HTTP client, OAuth flow, provider invocation, uploader or DB integration.
impact.adminVisibility: Console JSON plus internal Vietnamese handoff; no UI or public projection of operator materials.
impact.privacySafety: Public sources, approved brand and ProductTruth only; no private user data, channel tokens or Mây assets.
impact.observability: Offline proposed calendar and pending metric definitions; source hashes and blocker codes; no invented live KPI/cost.
impact.rollback: Remove only this new optional studio slice; execution is disabled by construction and existing Growth is unaffected.

canonicalContracts: Existing Nilaza ProductTruth and BrandPack own product and brand claims.
New packages/growth-nilaza/youtube/studio.json owns this isolated draft lane; adapter-contract.json is a proposed ContentOps boundary.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Current source applies feature preflight, seven impact fields, scoped tests and source/install parity; this dry-only lane introduces no exception.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Current guidelines and manifest remain authoritative; work briefs require brand/source rights and independent review, without changing masters.

dependencyReview.evidence: Node v25.9.0 observed; no new packages/install. Planner uses Node built-ins. Existing renderer is carousel-only, not a video renderer. YouTube APIs/policies are a future integration boundary only.

externalSourceReview.reason: OAuth upload requirements and private-only restriction for unaudited API projects; do not hardcode volatile quota costs.
Scheduling requires private never-published video; past timestamps can publish immediately.
Future authenticated mine=true identity check must match pinned Nilaza channel.
External Testing refresh tokens generally expire after seven days for scopes beyond basic identity.
Current synthetic-media disclosure boundaries and independent editorial assessment.
Parent-researched Studio invited permissions do not establish YouTube API authorization; live authorization remains unverified.

securityReview.authzRls: No authenticated endpoint or SQL changes. Channel pin and verified OAuth identity are mandatory future gates; current dry planner cannot execute.
securityReview.sensitiveData: No raw chat, journal, birth profiles, faces, audience contacts or real metrics; editorial examples are explicitly hypotheses.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No env credential reads, token creation or secret printing. Metadata-only evidence references; adapter receives credential-free draft envelopes.
securityReview.externalInput: Research is data, not authority. Rights, date, claim provenance and disclosure must be checked; ambiguous results and missing evidence stop the workflow.
securityReview.dependencies: No new dependencies. Existing shared roles/quality policy are referenced and hash-pinned, not forked; ContentOps queue is an external unverified dependency.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No migration, cloud project, deployment, push or paid provider work; proposed schedules are internal candidates only.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop on source drift, cross-tenant paths, stale approval, missing channel identity/OAuth/budget/adapter or any attempted external action.

workingTreeReview.note: Only these newly created optional YouTube slice paths are owned by this task. No existing concurrent source, Growth runtime, approved pilot, database or remote changes were edited.

managerTestPath: Read the internal handoff and eight role briefs; run weekly dry planner, inspect proposed future slots and explicit activation blockers. Change a fixture channel/hash/rights/budget to see rejection; no live calls.
residualRisk: No video, model/audio provider, OAuth identity, channel URL, approved API budget, ContentOps consumer acceptance or live scheduling/measurement evidence yet. A configuration/test PASS is not autonomous operation.
